intentional_boundaries: Native uninstall deliberately deletes selected app-owned business tables; reinstall does not silently restore link data. Data-preserving suspension is a different operation.

Current reviewed fresh restore supports unresolved failed operations. Arbitrary rollback of a completed uninstall/checkpoint is not established; it needs an explicit independently approved current-authority workflow.
Source removal requires complete protected database inventory; unknown/retained DBs cannot be silently omitted. Cleanup was exact archived owned-test retirement, not a guard bypass.
Old or ambiguous request keys are not automatically recycled. A fresh key is used only for an explicitly reconciled new business intent; retries of that intent retain the key.
Trusted native/same-origin code and qualified immutable combinations only; no hostile-plugin sandbox or general ABI promise.
